module: Career starting mode "apmOnboarding" (tier major, order 100, image start_apm.jpg): this is the start with tutorial. This file does not return an extension module but a simple description table, loaded by career/career.lua from the startingModes folder. It starts the money at 0 and prepares the tutorial vehicles with gameplay_tutorial_setup.setupVehicles().
notes: The fields id, order, tier and image describe the mode; initPlayerAttributes and setupInventory are called by the career startup code.
The title and description are not defined in this file (present in sandbox and selfMade).

initPlayerAttributes.desc: Initializes the player's attributes: money = 0 (label "Starting Capital").
